title: Divergence: callee_takes_string_byteview name-collision misroutes a user String-scanning spec fn — lower.rs callee_takes_string_byteview diverges from .design/basis/07-strings.md REQ-4

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_byteview_name_collision.rs::user_spec_fn_named_like_a_generated_byteview_fn_still_certifies_l3 demonstrates the divergence: two byte-identical String-scanning spec fns (the proven #126 spec_scan/spec_line_start shape) certify DIFFERENTLY by NAME. Control 'scan_x' -> L3; rename to 'is_digit' (a name in the fixed callee_takes_string_byteview set parse_le/parse_be/all_digits/is_digit/occurs_at/contains_sub/count_sep/sep_free) -> L0. The &String self-call arg is misrouted to .data@ (Seq<u8>) against the &TString param the lowered signature declares (E0308). Root cause: callee_takes_string_byteview keys the byte-view rewrite on callee NAME, not the &String param SHAPE. Authority: .design/basis/07-strings.md REQ-4 (String-scanning spec fn MUST lower + certify; the set is SHAPE-derived). Reproduced directly: forge check on /tmp fixtures, is_digit L0 vs scan_x L3, isolated by rename-only. Fix is generator's (owning crate thermite-lower).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
FIXED (#127): byte-view dispatch + generated-def emission are now SHAPE-keyed, not callee-NAME-keyed.

Root cause had TWO faces of the same name-keying bug:
1. callee_takes_string_byteview (lower.rs) keyed the String->.data@ rewrite on a fixed name set; a user spec fn named like a generated one got its &String self-call arg misrouted to .data@ (E0308).
2. program_uses_parse/_numfmt/_string_search keyed the GENERATED-def emission on a name match; a user 'spec fn is_digit(s: &String, ..)' spuriously materialized the generated is_digit(b: u8) ALONGSIDE the user's -> E0428 (name defined twice).

Fix (single file, thermite-lower/src/lower.rs):
- user_string_spec_fn_names(program): program-wide SHAPE-derived set of USER spec fns declaring a String/&String param (the user namespace; shadows any generated name).
- callee_takes_string_byteview now excludes a callee in that set BEFORE the generated-name match (Ctx.is_user_string_spec_fn) -> a user String spec fn passes the &TString reference, never .data@.
- the three emission gates exclude shadowed names so a user-named collision does not emit the generated def.

Param-type signal: a user spec fn declares &String/String (is_string_ty sees through one borrow); the generated fns take Seq<u8> and are synthesized (not in program.items), so they still byteview.

Verification (real verus 0.2026.05.24):
- divergence_byteview_name_collision (un-ignored): 1 passed. user is_digit -> L3; control scan_x -> L3.
- spec_fn_string_param: 2 passed. string_search/string_format/option_result/editor_runs: all green.
- cargo test --workspace: 670 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored.
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings: clean. cargo fmt --all --check: clean.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Fix the byteview dispatch (and the generated-def emission gates) to key on the callee's PARAM SHAPE, not its NAME. A user spec fn declaring &String/String shadows any generated def of that name: exclude such names from callee_takes_string_byteview AND from program_uses_parse/_numfmt/_string_search so a user is_digit(&String) passes the &TString ref and does not materialize the generated is_digit(u8). Single file: thermite-lower/src/lower.rs. Un-ignore the pin and run the full gauntlet with real verus.
